metas.name: Six Men Getting Sick
metas.description: Lynch's first film project consists of a looping animation of six people vomiting projected on to a special sculptured screen featuring twisted three-dimensional faces.

metas.name: Sailing with Bushnell Keeler
metas.description: In 1967, a young David Lynch grabbed his new Bolex 16mm camera, to film his friend and mentor Bushnell Keeler and brother Dave Keeler sailing on the Chesapeake Bay in Bush's King's Cruiser. This was David Lynch's very first film, which he prefers to call a "home movie". It depicts a man, a painter, who changed David's life forever pursuing the artist's life, which he continues to this day.

metas.name: Fictitious Anacin Commercial
metas.description: Parody of '60s Anacin commercials.

metas.name: Absurd Encounter with Fear
metas.description: A man approaches a woman in a field.

metas.name: The Alphabet
metas.description: A woman's dark and absurdist nightmare vision comprising a continuous recitation of the alphabet and bizarre living representations of each letter.

metas.name: The Grandmother
metas.description: To escape neglect and abuse from his parents, a young boy plants some strange seeds and they grow into a grandmother.

metas.name: The Amputee
metas.description: A double amputee attempts to write a letter while her nurse gets in the way.

metas.name: Eraserhead
metas.description: First-time father Henry Spencer tries to survive his industrial environment, his angry girlfriend, and the unbearable screams of his newly born mutant child.

metas.name: The Elephant Man
metas.description: A Victorian surgeon rescues a heavily disfigured man being mistreated by his "owner" as a side-show freak. Behind his monstrous façade, there is revealed a person of great intelligence and sensitivity.

metas.name: Dune
metas.description: In the year 10,191, the most precious substance in the universe is the spice Melange. The spice extends life. The spice expands consciousness. The spice is vital to space travel.  The spice exists on only one planet in the entire universe, the vast desert planet Arrakis, also known as Dune.  Its native inhabitants, the Fremen, have long held a prophecy that a man would come, a messiah who would lead them to true freedom.

metas.name: Blue Velvet
metas.description: The discovery of a severed human ear found in a field leads a young man on an investigation related to a beautiful, mysterious nightclub singer and a group of psychopathic criminals who have kidnapped her child.

metas.name: Ruth, Roses, and Revolver
metas.description: Television documentary from  BBCs Arena program in which David Lynch, fresh off the release of Blue Velvet, examines his surrealistic influences in cinema which excerpts from several classics works of the avant-garde

metas.name: The Cowboy and the Frenchman
metas.description: A grizzled, hard-of-hearing cowboy, Slim, and his two friends, Dusty and Pete, capture a mysterious, well-dressed Frenchman.

metas.name: Twin Peaks
metas.description: The body of Laura Palmer is washed up on a beach near the small Washington state town of Twin Peaks. FBI Special Agent Dale Cooper is called in to investigate her strange demise only to uncover a web of mystery that ultimately leads him deep into the heart of the surrounding woodland and his very own soul.

metas.name: Wild at Heart
metas.description: Young lovers Sailor and Lula hit the road to start a new life together away from the wrath of Lula’s deranged, disapproving mother, who has hired a team of hitmen to cut the lovers’ surreal honeymoon short.

metas.name: Industrial Symphony No. 1: The Dream of the Brokenhearted
metas.description: After her boyfriend ends their relationship, the dreamself of a heartbroken woman floats through the air over an industrial wasteland singing ballads of love.

metas.name: Twin Peaks
metas.description: An idiosyncratic FBI agent investigates the murder of a young woman in the even more idiosyncratic town of Twin Peaks. (This standalone version of the series pilot was produced for the European VHS market and has an alternate, closed ending.)

metas.name: Thought Gang: A Real Indication
metas.description: A music video for the track 'A Real Indication' which appears on the Album 'Thought Gang'.

metas.name: On the Air
metas.description: Czars of the bizarre, Mark Frost & David Lynch have concocted a new series that shows the perils of live television during the "Golden Age of Television." Complete with the usual odd assortment of strange characters that would normally be associated with a Lynch / Frost production. Music for the series was composed and conducted by Angelo Badalamenti.  In an attempt to revive his failing career, movie star Lester Guy has agreed to star in this new live variety show for the Zoblotnick Broadcasting Company (ZBC). The owner of the network sends his nephew, from the old country, to direct this show...

metas.name: Twin Peaks: Fire Walk with Me
metas.description: In the questionable town of Deer Meadow, Washington, FBI Agent Desmond inexplicably disappears while hunting for the man who murdered a teen girl. The killer is never apprehended, and, after experiencing dark visions and supernatural encounters, Agent Dale Cooper chillingly predicts that the culprit will claim another life. Meanwhile, in the more cozy town of Twin Peaks, hedonistic beauty Laura Palmer hangs with lowlifes and seems destined for a grisly fate.

metas.name: Hotel Room
metas.description: The lives of several people spanning from 1936 to 1993 are chronicled during their overnight stay at a New York City hotel room.

metas.name: Lost Highway
metas.description: A tormented jazz musician finds himself lost in an enigmatic story involving murder, surveillance, gangsters, doppelgängers, and an impossible transformation inside a prison cell.

metas.name: Mulholland Dr.
metas.description: The original TV pilot version of Mulholland Drive, telling the story of an amnesiac woman in Los Angeles who sets out to uncover the secrets of her own past with the help of a wannabe actress. Filmed in early 1999 and never aired, this version has only ever circulated in bootleg form. Additional photography took place in late 2000 and the pilot material was reworked into the 2001 feature film.

metas.name: The Straight Story
metas.description: Retired farmer and widower Alvin Straight learns one day that his estranged brother Lyle has suffered a severe stroke. Alvin is determined to make things right with Lyle while he still can, but his brother lives in Wisconsin, while Alvin is stuck in Iowa with no car and no driver's license. He then has the idea of making the trip on his old lawnmower, thus beginning a picturesque and at times deeply spiritual odyssey.

metas.name: One Morning All Over the World
metas.description: An ad for an advertising company, consisting of 7-second sequence shots by 13 directors.

metas.name: Mulholland Drive
metas.description: Blonde Betty Elms has only just arrived in Hollywood to become a movie star when she meets an enigmatic brunette with amnesia. Meanwhile, as the two set off to solve the second woman's identity, filmmaker Adam Kesher runs into ominous trouble while casting his latest project.

metas.name: BlueBob: Thank You Judge
metas.description: Influenced by John Lee Hooker, the music video incorporates elements of electricity and the raw sound of Rock and Roll, as a hapless, freshly dumped man sings about how the cruel judge sided with his ex-wife, and how she took everything.

metas.name: Head with Hammer
metas.description: An aspect of life.

metas.name: Factory Mask
metas.description: Suddenly, in the cramped boiler room, a pressure-relief valve opens and discharges steam. Then, a certified technician approaches to perform a routine check. But, is he wearing his factory mask?

metas.name: Laura Palmer
metas.description: Against the backdrop of a silky, bubblegum-pink curtain, the abused, traumatised, and emotionally broken teenage homecoming queen, Laura Palmer, the pivotal character of Twin Peaks (1990), and Twin Peaks: Fire Walk with Me (1992), seems lost in thought. What does she see? What does she hear? As the ill-fated student struggles to harness lingering questions, the haunting theme of Angelo Badalamenti intensifies the elaborate mystery, and the tragedy of loss concludes with a climactic close-up of once-happy Laura Palmer.—Nick Riganas

metas.name: DumbLand
metas.description: A series of eight crudely animated shorts written, directed, and voiced by director David Lynch in 2002. The series details the daily routines of a dull-witted white trash man. The man lives in a house along with his frazzled wife and squeaky-voiced child, both of whom are nameless as is the man in the shows.

metas.name: Out Yonder — Neighbor Boy
metas.description: Humorous short film in which David Lynch and his son Austin observe the follies of their neighbor.

metas.name: Pierre and Sonny Jim
metas.description: Life can be hard on planet Earth, especially when you're running out of air.

metas.name: Dead Mouse with Ants
metas.description: Features a dead mouse with ants on it.

metas.name: Coyote #1
metas.description: A coyote somehow finds a way to a motel room.

metas.name: BlueBob Egg
metas.description: Before our very eyes, BlueBob gets arrested in broad daylight.

metas.name: Darkened Room
metas.description: Two young women find themselves in a dark room where there is a distinctly strange feeling.

metas.name: Premonitions Following an Evil Deed
metas.description: A short film about the events following a murder.

metas.name: The Pig Walks
metas.description: No one knows what has been going on behind the closed doors of the city's macabre and noisome abattoir.

metas.name: Rabbits
metas.description: A story of a group of humanoid rabbits and their depressive, daily life. The plot includes Suzie ironing, Jane sitting on a couch, Jack walking in and out of the apartment, and the occasional solo singing number by Suzie or Jane. At one point the rabbits also make contact with their “leader”.

metas.name: Bees
metas.description: An incessant buzzing noise catches the attention of the indefatigable American filmmaker, David Lynch, who, without delay, starts filming one of the most extraordinary defensive moves in nature: the mighty bee ball.

metas.name: Industrial Soundscape
metas.description: Music is produced by different objects in an industrial and desolate landscape.

metas.name: The Disc of Sorrow Is Installed
metas.description: The Disc of Sorrow gets installed.

metas.name: Lamp
metas.description: Short documentary of David Lynch building a lamp.

metas.name: Boat
metas.description: A journey into night.

metas.name: Intervalometer Experiments
metas.description: David Lynch experiments with time and photography in three different locations.

metas.name: Bug Crawls
metas.description: In a solemn, haunted environment, a small bug crawls over the silhouette of a house.

metas.name: Inland Empire
metas.description: When actress Nikki Grace gets the lead role in a cursed film, her world becomes more and more surreal, blending realities and ideas of infidelity, reincarnation, and supernatural forces.

metas.name: Working with Marilyn Manson
metas.description: Against the backdrop of scarlet velvet drapes, the indefatigable American auteur, David Lynch, answers a question from a fan about the American singer, Marilyn Manson, reminiscing about his seventh feature, Lost Highway (1997).

metas.name: Scissors
metas.description: Amid the palpable darkness of the local cinema, a film about dancing gradually transforms into a surreal experience of psychological horror, as four friends struggle to interpret the strikingly realistic and blood-curdling on-screen imagery.

metas.name: More Things That Happened
metas.description: A collection of deleted scenes from David Lynch's 2006 surrealist horror INLAND EMPIRE.

metas.name: Blue Green
metas.description: Blue Green is a surreal, ambient short film capturing the mood and the lone tone of a giant industrial setting.

metas.name: Ballerina
metas.description: David Lynch turns this digital video of a ballerina into an impressionistic exercise.

metas.name: Hollyshorts Greeting
metas.description: A fun short piece that Lynch presented as his acceptance for the Hollyshorts 2008 Visionary Award.

metas.name: Twin Peaks Festival Greeting 2008
metas.description: A surreal short film that Lynch made for the 2008 Twin Peaks Festival. It only screened once and is in black and white. In this film, Lynch is speaking backwards in what looks to be a cross between the floors of Eraserhead and the Twin Peaks Red Room. Sitting next to him is a plastic doll with the face of Laura Palmer.

metas.name: Early Experiments
metas.description: A 16mm film experiment conducted in 1967 and 1968 in Philadelphia which feature small parts of the Alphabet and the Grandmother.

metas.name: Interview Project
metas.description: A series of brief interviews produced by filmmaker David Lynch shot over 70 days across 20,000 miles of the United States featuring hundreds of different Americans.

metas.name: 42 One Dream Rush
metas.description: An omnibus project bringing together acclaimed directors from around the world, each contributing a 42-second short inspired by a dream. Produced by 42 Below vodka, the collection blends surreal, poetic, and experimental visions into a mosaic of oneiric cinema.

metas.name: Duran Duran: Unstaged
metas.description: Duran Duran: Unstaged is a multimedia event that takes the audience on a cinematic journey with one of the most successful acts in the world during their performance at the Mayan Theater in Los Angeles.

metas.name: Interpol: I Touch a Red Button
metas.description: “I Touch a Red Button Man” is a 2011 animated short film directed by renowned filmmaker David Lynch for Interpol's song “Lights.”

metas.name: Blue Velvet: The Lost Footage
metas.description: Fifty-two minutes of deleted scenes and alternate takes assembled by David Lynch.

metas.name: David Lynch: Crazy Clown Time
metas.description: An ensemble of oddball characters provide percussion in a nondescript backyard while Lynch's lyrics flatly detail what's happening.

metas.name: Memory Film
metas.description: Experimental short created for the 7th annual Memory Marathon at London’s Serpentine Gallery, exploring the theme of memory through image and sound.

metas.name: Idem Paris
metas.description: A nearly wordless portrait of the renowned fine art printing studio in Paris, capturing the intricate process of lithography.

metas.name: Nine Inch Nails: Came Back Haunted
metas.description: A promotional music video for Nine Inch Nails' 2013 single, directed by David Lynch.

metas.name: Twin Peaks: The Missing Pieces
metas.description: A feature-length compilation of deleted and alternate takes from Twin Peaks: Fire Walk with Me, assembled by creator David Lynch to continue the story of the final week of Laura Palmer’s life.

metas.name: Ergo-Robots
metas.description: Ergo-Robots (2015) is a short film co-directed by David Lynch and Pierre-Yves Oudeyer. It was produced in collaboration with INRIA's FLOWERS research team, which specializes in machine learning and developmental robotics.

metas.name: Fire (Pożar)
metas.description: Lynch made the animation film Pożar (Fire) in 2015 after the Polish-American composer Marek Zebrowski created a musical composition as a tribute to him. The film was included in the 2018 retrospective "Someone Is In My House".

metas.name: David Lynch's Comic-Con Message
metas.description: David Lynch shares a message on a Twin Peaks (2017) Comic-Con panel.

metas.name: Ant Head
metas.description: Ants gather and consume a head-like shape in a static, abstract composition set to experimental music.

metas.name: WHAT DID JACK DO?
metas.description: In a locked down train station, a homicide detective conducts an interview with a tormented monkey  who is suspected of murder.

metas.name: What Is David Lynch Working on Today?
metas.description: A collection of video logs that answer the question 'What Is David Lynch Working on Today?' David works on a wood sink, urinal, checking stick, microphone stand, litho signing, phone holder, pants repair, paint drawers, varnishing, mirror, the jar, balls, thinking, dowel, sculpture, wall sconce and teaching.

metas.name: The Adventures of Alan R.
metas.description: This is a 90 second short film where a severed head on a black room type patterned floor repeats a statement about "not going fishing today."

metas.name: The Story of a Small Bug
metas.description: David Lynch documents the story of a small bug.

metas.name: The Spider and the Bee
metas.description: Two deadly insects, locked in a battle to the death; the Spider (determined to devour prey) and the Bee (armored to fight back).

metas.name: The Mystery of the Seeing Hand
metas.description: David Lynch Theater Presents:  THE MYSTERY OF THE SEEING HAND

metas.name: Chrystabell & David Lynch: Sublime Eternal Love
metas.description: Music video for Chrystabell and David Lynch's song "Sublime Eternal Love" from their album "Cellophane Memories".

metas.name: We'll Deliver 'Em
metas.description: Two stock-footage train operators find out about David Lynch's new album with Chrystabell.

metas.name: Chrystabell & David Lynch: The Answers to the Questions
metas.description: Music video for Chrystabell and David Lynch's song "The Answers to the Questions" from their album "Cellophane Memories".

metas.name: I Have a Radio
metas.description: Two animated figures dance to the  song "I Have a Radio" by David Lynch.
